news_variations.text: US and Iran resume direct negotiations in Doha on July 18, focusing on Strait of Hormuz and regional stability. European governments accept potential transit fees for shipping. Saudi Arabia increased crude oil exports following US-Iran truce. US maintains naval presence with two aircraft carriers.
